tut.help.title: Help
tut.drive: Driving: throttle, brake and steering are your tools in the city.
tut.drive.kb: Driving: W/Up = throttle, S/Down = brake, A/D = steer, Space = handbrake.
tut.drive.pad: Driving: right trigger = throttle, left trigger = brake, left stick = steer, X = handbrake.
tut.map: Open the map to see districts and objectives.
tut.map.kb: Press M for the map. Click to set a waypoint.
tut.heat: You have been noticed. Wanted pressure differs per district.
tut.heat.kb: Wanted: leave the district, hide and wait for the stars to fade.
tut.heat.pad: Wanted: leave the district, hide and wait for the stars to fade.
tut.aegis: Aegis scans your plate. In Rustline almost no cameras are active.
tut.aegis.kb: Aegis cameras report you. Avoid Kestrel Core if your profile is flagged.
tut.aegis.pad: Aegis cameras report you. Avoid Kestrel Core if your profile is flagged.
tut.garage: Garage: switch and tune your vehicles here.
tut.garage.kb: Garage: press Enter to switch and tune vehicles.
tut.garage.pad: Garage: press A to switch and tune vehicles.
tut.mission: New mission: follow the marker on the map.
tut.mission.kb: New mission: follow the marker. The journal (J) has the description.
tut.mission.pad: New mission: follow the marker. Find the journal in the pause menu.
tut.choice: Decision: your choice changes faction standing and the story.
tut.choice.kb: Decision: choose with keys 1 to 4. The result is permanent.
tut.choice.pad: Decision: choose with the D-pad and confirm with A.
tut.save: Saving: progress is saved automatically. You can also save manually.
tut.save.kb: Quick save with F5, quick load with F9. Slots are in the pause menu.
tut.save.pad: Find save slots in the pause menu (Start).
tut.photo.kb: Photo mode with F6 or via the pause menu. Enter takes a photo.
tut.photo.pad: Photo mode via the pause menu. A takes a photo.
tut.reset: Stuck? You can reset your vehicle.
tut.reset.kb: Press R to put your vehicle back on its wheels.
tut.reset.pad: Press Y to put your vehicle back on its wheels.
tut.radio: Radio: five fictional stations accompany your drive.
tut.radio.kb: Radio: change station with the arrow keys in a vehicle.
tut.radio.pad: Radio: change station with the D-pad in a vehicle.
tut.drift: Handbrake: short taps make the rear slide.
tut.drift.kb: Tap Space in corners to drift.
tut.drift.pad: Tap X in corners to drift.
tut.night: At night Rustline and Lantern Hill are dark. Drive with your lights on.
tut.night.kb: Night driving: take care, sidewalks and junctions are poorly lit.
tut.night.pad: Night driving: take care, sidewalks and junctions are poorly lit.
tut.access: Accessibility: text, contrast, color blind modes and steering assist are in Options.
tut.access.kb: Options > Accessibility: text, contrast, color blind modes, steering assist, one-button mode.
tut.access.pad: Options > Accessibility: text, contrast, color blind modes, steering assist, one-button mode.
tut.help.footer: F1 opens this help at any time.
